definitions.means_only: Only the seven context-conditioned level means; drop all 15 change coordinates per bin.
definitions.change_only: Drop seven level means; keep delta mean, delta RMS and joint Tempo-Dynamics moment.
definitions.mean_centered: Subtract same-recording, same-search-view global signed mean from each of seven context means; other coordinates unchanged.
definitions.shared_variance: Between-recording variance of level coordinates decomposed into a shared three-bin component and bin contrasts; channel-scaled using gallery global-mean SD; family-balanced across the frozen 335 recordings.
definitions.correlations: Signed Pearson correlation between context mean and same-view global signed mean, family-balanced. Within-piece correlations first subtract each piece mean. B uses median absolute rubato, so B is not identical to the seven signed global means.
definitions.retrieval: Same gallery, per-family top-5 cap, opposite-view saved judges, gallery-only SD and distance-median calibration; no tuning.

limitations: Exploratory diagnostics chosen after viewing prior results, not a preregistered success test.
Only three test and three validation families; no population inference.
No tension-specific judge, no new phrase truth, no new model.
Delta coordinates may still encode overall change scale; removing levels is not removing all range information.
Shared-level variance fraction concerns level coordinates only, not all 66/198 coordinates.
Main comparisons retain unequal candidate counts by work; exact same-work expectation and existing twenty balanced-gallery seeds are included.
